name: deaths
description: Kit players (the kits_idle roster) killed by another player every `period` ticks, `victims` at a time, through a real player_attack damage so the whole death path runs: vanilla death counters, the death-cause advancement, stats collection and kill attribution, elo, kill_streak rewards, cosmetics death effects, cleanup_after_death and the diorama owner cleanup. The dead actor respawns on the next tick (PackTest respawn), is put back on its grid slot and re-equips its kit like a player leaving the lobby.
